sv.title: Utesluter inte SD-samarbete i intervju: ”Vet jag inte ännu”
sv.summary: I en SVT-intervju utesluter C-ledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist inte ett samarbete med SD. – Det vet jag inte ännu. Vi fattar beslut inom partiet, säger hon. Kort efter intervjun hör C-ledaren av sig på nytt.

en.title: Does not rule out cooperation with SD in interview: "I don't know yet"
en.summary: In an SVT interview, Centre Party leader Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist does not rule out cooperation with the Sweden Democrats. "I don't know that yet. We make decisions within the party," she says. Shortly after the interview, the Centre Party leader gets back in touch again.
